title: Battle of Ameixial
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ameixial", at revision 1370106658, opens: "The Battle of Ameixial, was fought on 8 June 1663, near the village of Santa Vitória do Ameixial, some 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) north-west of Estremoz, between Spanish and Portuguese as part of the Portuguese Restoration War. In Spain, the battle is better known as the Battle of Estremoz." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2887851, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1663 battle of the Portuguese Restoration War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
